caption: The drawing displays a detailed monochrome illustration of a jug or pitcher with a rounded body, a flared spout, and an ornate handle. The body of the jug features vertically elongated, petal-like segments that extend from the base upward. The handle is thick, structured, and curved, attached at the top and bottom of the jug's neck and shoulder, respectively, with ornamental curls at both ends. At the top center of the paper is a circular seal or medallion depicting several human figures in a landscape with the sun and rays in the background, inscribed around the edge with the word "EXCELSIOR" and additional text. Below the medallion, the names "Joseph" and "Curtis" appear in cursive script. In the lower left corner, there is a smaller, simpler outline drawing of the jug, shown from the front, with dimensions marked as "10 1/2 in." The entire drawing is done in shades of black and gray on a lightly yellowed background, giving it an old, archival appearance.
title: Silver Water Pitcher
